# Senior Production Site Reliability Engineer - PH — Disney Television Animation

---
**Job ID:** 10162977
**Date Posted:** Nov 6, 2026
**Date Applied:** Nov 7, 2026
**Salary Range:** $144,100–$193,200 per year — Glendale, CA (the posting prints the low end as "$144.100")
---

## Job Summary

A Project Hire role, with no guarantee of full-time placement, on the Disney Kids & Family (DKF) Technology team, which supports the Disney Television Animation studio's live-action and animated content for Disney Channel, Disney Junior, Disney XD, and Disney+. The Senior Production Systems Reliability Engineer develops and supports cloud solutions for DKF productions and automates the production application processes behind its digital production products, centered on Unreal Engine and Perforce P4 infrastructure.

---

## What You'll Do

- Architect, deploy, and maintain Unreal Engine and Perforce P4 infrastructure on-prem and in the cloud, including build, caching (DDC), and version-control services.
- Administer and scale Perforce P4, including depot design, replica/edge/proxy topology, and Helix Code Review, for distributed animation and virtual-production teams.
- Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for Unreal Engine projects, and support rendering and pipeline automation, including integration with render orchestration such as AWS Deadline.
- Deliver cloud-native (AWS, Azure, GCP) and in-house infrastructure; migrate applications and servers between local and cloud deployments.
- Manage, configure, and implement Terraform, Helm, GitLab, Docker, and Kubernetes; develop software to automate, monitor, and maintain deployed infrastructure.
- Work with product developers and the Software Development group on operational support, tooling, and automation of hardware and software resources.
- Create telemetry for monitoring, engineer high reliability, and reinforce security best practices for company and guest data.
- Design and develop front-end applications for automation and tools as needed; generate reports and statistics across systems.
- Automate and support physical and virtual environments for web and application servers; provide third-tier support to Systems Engineering, Support Engineering, and Software Development.

### Required Qualifications
- 5+ years supporting high-end graphics workflows
- 5+ years supporting (advanced troubleshooting and configuration) Linux/UNIX, Mac OS, and Windows systems in a network environment
- 5+ years with network administration utilities
- Unreal Engine in an animation, live-action, or virtual production environment
- Perforce P4 at an administrative level (server topology, replication, Code Review)
- Understanding of real-time / production-animation workflows and how Unreal integrates with DCC and render pipelines (Maya, Nuke, AWS Deadline)
- Strong Linux/Unix/Windows administration; prior work as a Cloud, Automation, or Full Stack Engineer
- Scripting and programming for web app development (Python, PowerShell, React, Rust, bash, etc.)
- AWS, Azure, and GCP, including cloud migration strategies
- CI/CD tools (GitLab, Jenkins) and Docker/Kubernetes; virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V, Docker) automation
- Configuration management and infrastructure as code (Ansible, Terraform, CloudFormation)
- MySQL and SQL databases; load balancers (NginX, F5, AWS)
- Active Directory and identity management (IDP, SAML, LDAP)
- Preferred: ToonBoom, Maya, and Nuke; pipeline automation and rendering with AWS Deadline
- Strong written and verbal communication and a strong customer-service orientation

### Education
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent work experience required.

### Benefits
A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Nov 7, 2026

- **Infrastructure and automation are the real overlap:** Windows/Linux systems administration, Docker and containerized applications, Proxmox virtualization, reverse proxy and firewall routing, DNS, DHCP, and VLANs in `skills.json`; a redundant Kubernetes cluster running a self-developed ERP/CRM (Filament era); and ExtrusionStudio, a Python service on a headless Debian server, live on all three extrusion lines since October 2026 with no unplanned outage during production, with a fleet of Raspberry Pi kiosks it updates and power-switches.
- **Automation and tooling:** RB's Auto App Updater (PowerShell, WinGet, an elevated scheduled task, SHA-256-verified self-update), BulkSSH (TypeScript/Electron SSH fleet tool), and this site's GitHub Actions workflow and continuous deployment on Vercel answer "develop software to automate, monitor, and maintain" and "front-end applications for automation and tools". Python, PowerShell, and React are on the record; Rust and bash are not.
- **Third-tier support and reports:** Riley is the plant's technical subject-matter expert and escalation point, isolated the packing-bench fault layer by layer at the ExtrusionStudio rollout, writes incident reports for leadership, and presents status at Proteor's monthly USA review.
- **Gaps:** nothing on the record establishes Unreal Engine, Perforce P4, AWS Deadline, Maya, Nuke, ToonBoom, or any graphics, animation, or virtual-production workflow, so the 5-year "high-end graphics workflows" requirement is unmet. No AWS or GCP and no Azure administration (Business Central is SaaS Microsoft operates), no Terraform, Helm, GitLab, Jenkins, Ansible, or CloudFormation, no VMware or Hyper-V, no MySQL (SQLite only), no dedicated load balancers, no Active Directory/SAML/LDAP, and no Mac OS administration. These were kept out of the resume.
- **Fit:** a long shot on the graphics and Perforce core of the role; the resume leads with production reliability, Linux/Windows infrastructure, and automation, which is the honest overlap.

### Now — Nov 7, 2026

Nothing has changed since the application.

## About the Company

The Disney Kids & Family (DKF) group oversees the creation, development, and production of live-action and animated television content for children, teenagers, and families through the Disney Television Animation studio, aired on Disney Channel, Disney Junior, Disney XD, and Disney+. The Walt Disney Company is a diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise operating in more than 40 countries.
